title: Introduce governed task, evidence and independent-review loop
goal: Add the smallest reusable AI OS control plane to CareGist without changing production behaviour, live Stripe state or the current £795 Territory Opportunity Brief commercial decision.
definition_of_done: A versioned constitution prevents an implementation agent from self-certifying COMPLETE.
A machine-readable task ledger carries explicit status, definition of done, tests, evidence, independent review, verification and risk fields.
The governance verifier fails closed when PASS, VERIFIED or COMPLETE is claimed without the required independent evidence.
The £795 Territory Opportunity Brief has a canonical commercial catalogue record and declared public surfaces are checked for drift.
Pull requests automatically publish a provider-neutral independent-review packet suitable for Grok or another non-implementing model.
Existing CareGist CI remains authoritative for code, security, migration, frontend and smoke evidence.
No production flags, live billing objects, webhook secrets, deployments or customer deliveries are changed by this task.
tests: Existing .github/workflows/ci.yml jobs remain green on the pull request
